// First-party DLL-entry exception control. No allocator, CRT or Rust runtime.
#![no_std]
use core::{ffi::c_void, sync::atomic::{AtomicU32, Ordering}};
#[repr(C)] struct ExceptionRecord { code:u32, flags:u32, nested:*mut c_void, address:*const u8 }
#[repr(C,align(16))] struct ContextPrefix {
    home:[u64;6], flags:u32, mxcsr:u32, segments:[u16;6], eflags:u32,
    debug:[u64;6], registers:[u64;16], rip:u64,
}
const _:()=assert!(core::mem::offset_of!(ContextPrefix,rip)==248);
#[repr(C)] struct ExceptionPointers { record:*const ExceptionRecord, context:*mut ContextPrefix }
static PHASE:AtomicU32=AtomicU32::new(0);
static HANDLED:AtomicU32=AtomicU32::new(0);
#[link(name="kernel32")] unsafe extern "system" {
    fn AddVectoredExceptionHandler(first:u32,handler:unsafe extern "system" fn(*mut ExceptionPointers)->i32)->*mut c_void;
    fn RemoveVectoredExceptionHandler(handle:*mut c_void)->u32;
    fn RaiseException(code:u32,flags:u32,count:u32,args:*const usize);
    fn DebugBreak();
    fn GetCurrentProcess()->*mut c_void;
    fn ReadProcessMemory(process:*mut c_void,address:*const c_void,buffer:*mut c_void,size:usize,read:*mut usize)->i32;
    fn ExitProcess(code:u32)->!;
}
#[panic_handler] fn panic(_: &core::panic::PanicInfo<'_>)->! {unsafe{ExitProcess(49)}}
unsafe fn remove_handler(handle:*mut c_void) {
    // A registered pointer must never outlive this DLL after failed attachment.
    if unsafe{RemoveVectoredExceptionHandler(handle)}==0 {unsafe{ExitProcess(48)}}
}
unsafe extern "system" fn handler(info:*mut ExceptionPointers)->i32 {
    if PHASE.load(Ordering::Acquire)!=1 || info.is_null() || unsafe{(*info).record.is_null()} {return 0;}
    let code=unsafe{(*(*info).record).code};
    if code!=0xe042_6666 && code!=0x8000_0003 {return 0;}
    if code==0x8000_0003 {
        let context=unsafe{(*info).context};
        if context.is_null() || unsafe{(*context).flags}&0x0010_0001!=0x0010_0001 {return 0;}
        let address=unsafe{(*(*info).record).address};
        let mut instruction=0u8;let mut read=0usize;
        if unsafe{ReadProcessMemory(GetCurrentProcess(),address.cast(),(&raw mut instruction).cast(),1,&raw mut read)}==0 || read!=1 || instruction!=0xcc {return 0;}
        let at=address as u64;
        let Some(after)=at.checked_add(1) else {return 0;};
        let rip=unsafe{(*context).rip};
        if rip==at {unsafe{(*context).rip=after};} else if rip!=after {return 0;}
    }
    HANDLED.fetch_add(1,Ordering::Relaxed);
    -1
}
// Explicit /ENTRY binding is verified against the compiled PE before admission.
// This no_std DLL never depends on CRT initialization or performs loader work.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub unsafe extern "system" fn owned_dll_entry(_: *mut c_void,reason:u32,_:*mut c_void)->i32 {
    if reason!=1 {return 1;}
    if !cfg!(target_arch="x86_64") {return 0;}
    PHASE.store(1,Ordering::Release);
    let handle=unsafe{AddVectoredExceptionHandler(1,handler)};
    if handle.is_null() {return 0;}
    unsafe{RaiseException(0xe042_6666,0,0,core::ptr::null());}
    if HANDLED.load(Ordering::Relaxed)!=1 {unsafe{remove_handler(handle)};return 0;}
    unsafe{DebugBreak();}
    if HANDLED.load(Ordering::Relaxed)!=2 {unsafe{remove_handler(handle)};return 0;}
    unsafe{remove_handler(handle)};
    PHASE.store(2,Ordering::Release);
    1
}
#[unsafe(no_mangle)] pub extern "system" fn owned_dll_receipt()->u32 {
    (PHASE.load(Ordering::Acquire)<<16)|HANDLED.load(Ordering::Relaxed)
}
